$comment: Atlanta seeds (D-040). Public calendars only; each is read through robots.txt, the denylist and the noindex/login checks, so a wrong or blocked URL costs one request and shows up as a skip in the dry run. URLs were written from public knowledge and have not been opened from this environment (no outbound access): every seed says so in its note until a person checks it. Georgia State is left out here because the D-037 importer already reads its Localist calendar and PIN.
